description: Live headers for omacus.com. GitHub Pages does not send site/_headers. app.omacus.com already sends its policy from site/app/_headers; this rule adds the same HSTS there.

rules.expression: (http.host eq "omacus.com" or http.host eq "www.omacus.com") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/app")

Content-Security-Policy.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://static.cloudflareinsights.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://cloudflareinsights.com; media-src 'self'; frame-src 'self' https://app.omacus.com; worker-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'self'

rules.description: Security headers for the omacus.com/app bridge
rules.expression: (http.host eq "omacus.com" or http.host eq "www.omacus.com") and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/app")

Content-Security-Policy.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline' https://static.cloudflareinsights.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://open.er-api.com https://sync.omacus.com https://cloudflareinsights.com; worker-src 'self'; frame-src 'self' https://app.omacus.com; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'self'
